highlights: Schematic connectivity and no-connect intent now survive moves, rotations, batch placement, region moves, and component replacement.
Placement automation now reads live board state when available and blocks unsafe, off-board, non-improving, or unbounded plans.
KiCad 10 project, hierarchy, template-instance, and legacy-net output is now canonical and fails closed when unsupported.
Native KiCad 10.0.6+ footprint flipping includes observed readback and the application's 3D-model transform.
Published PCM packages were independently downloaded, hash-verified, package-validated, and stamped into repository metadata.

compatibility.testedPlatforms: Release CI and packages passed on Windows, Linux, and macOS; real-KiCad E2E and eight live IPC tests passed before publication.
compatibility.guidanceStatus: Claude receives the bundled guidance; Codex users should pair this release with konnect-codex v0.12.1.
compatibility.mcpClientStatus: Konnect remains the native MCP tool source. Restart the client after upgrading so it starts the v0.12.1 server and refreshed catalogue.
compatibility.workflowStatus: Connectivity, placement, native flip, packaging, and the preserved end-to-end benchmark passed. Force-directed placement remains diagnostic and deprecated.
compatibility.restartSteps: Install Konnect v0.12.1, stop old Konnect sessions, and restart the MCP client.
compatibility.knownLimitations: Saved-file placement scores do not prove unsaved editor state; authored-courtyard spacing is not copper DRC; the native Specctra profile still does not cover every legal KiCad geometry form.

highlights: Rebased the exact 17-file upstream guidance baseline and pinned the v0.12.1 source and fingerprints.
Reclassified footprint flipping as native live-IPC preferred with a guarded closed-board fallback.
Updated Codex placement guidance to reject the deprecated force-directed cleanup path and require exact decoupling references.
Added atomic batch-placement junction evidence and retired the v0.12.0 missing-reference warning.
Retained the measured KiCad-native Freerouting compatibility bridge and the companion's broader workflow, evidence, and cleanup gates.

compatibility.testedPlatforms: CI passed on Windows, Linux, and macOS; exact-version matched to Konnect v0.12.1.
compatibility.guidanceStatus: 9 reviewed Codex skills, 5 specialist agents, structured hooks, and 28 active enhancements are installed and healthy.
compatibility.mcpClientStatus: Codex companion for Konnect v0.12.1; the native Konnect MCP catalogue remains the tool source.
compatibility.workflowStatus: Source audit, 26 tests, Clippy, dry-run publication, local sync, doctor, and all 45 managed files passed.
compatibility.restartSteps: Install the matching release, run konnect-codex sync and konnect-codex doctor, then start a new Codex task.
compatibility.knownLimitations: Use the companion release that exactly matches the installed Konnect release. Project-specific ERC, DRC, routing, and manufacturing evidence remain required.
